Defaults external finding offsets to Unicode code points

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_with_external_redaction, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(bytes=[90, 111, 195, 171, 120, 32, 101, 109, 97, 105, 108, 101, 100, 46], filename="external-findings-default.txt", kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"), mime_type="text/plain")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{}")
    findings_json = '[{"entity_type":"inspection_person","start":0,"end":3,"score":0.99,"analysis_explanation":{"recognizer":"spacy"}}]'
    max_findings = 8
    result = await extract_with_external_redaction(input, config, findings_json, None, max_findings)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
